description: Grid, Tower & Infrastructure Pipeline Near a Site — Screens a US site (latitude/longitude or Census-geocoded address) within a radius (default 10, max 50 miles) using primary public data: operating and planned generators and storage from EIA Form 860M, active interconnection-queue entries from MISO, CAISO, NYISO and ERCOT matched at county level, FCC Antenna Structure Registration towers, and HIFLD transmission lines and substations. Code computes

address.description: US street address, geocoded with the Census Bureau geocoder. Used when latitude/longitude are absent.

focus.description: Which screening signals to emphasise. Default general.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the site (United States and territories). Give latitude and longitude together, or address.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles (default 10, clamped to at most 50).

window_years.description: Window for capacity added within the radius (default 3 years).

name: infrastructure-pipeline-brief
